base: acrylic black and blue wiped down with thin liquid clear

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: dab white cloud shapes with the corner
steps.load: small amount of white on corner

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: add phthalo blue to the cloud shapes
steps.rule: letting colors show through makes interesting effects

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud edges with a clean dry brush
steps.rule: keeping variation makes the sky look stormy

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: paint a jagged mountain with the knife
steps.load: mixed dark, pulled flat, cut a row on knife

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: blend mountain paint downward
steps.rule: removing excess paint lets it blend down

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay snow on the mountain top with the knife
steps.load: white pulled flat and cut into a row

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: paint shadow valleys with blue and white
steps.load: blue and white mixed on knife
steps.rule: a dark valley reads as mysterious

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: add mist at the mountain base with a dry brush
steps.rule: clouds rolling in so mist appears at the base

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap clouds over the mountain base

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap small trees at the mountain base
steps.rule: dark base lets the light show later

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin sticks and trunks
steps.rule: twigs give birds a place to sit

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add light highlights to the trees
steps.load: liquid white dip, then blue and white

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add a big tree in the back

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: drop snow behind the trees
steps.load: white loaded to a chisel edge

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint big tree in front of the snow
steps.load: dark mix loaded full on round
steps.rule: snow goes in first so it reads as behind the tree

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint another tree on the other side
steps.rule: do not cover the whole mountain

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin tree trunks

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint limbs on the top of an old tree
steps.rule: old trees often show bare limbs at the top

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add highlights to the big tree
steps.rule: keeps the big tree from looking bare

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a cabin shape and mix brown
steps.load: green and crimson mixed to brown
steps.rule: scraping lays out the cabin and removes excess paint

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in the back eave with brown

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add planks with light brown touches
steps.load: brown mixed with a little white
steps.rule: touches give the look of old wood

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: paint dark door and window
steps.rule: a door lets you get in and out

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add snow to the cabin roof
steps.rule: snow on the roof keeps the cabin warm

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: paint a small bush near the cabin
steps.rule: helps the perspective of the painting

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: blend shadows under the bushes
steps.rule: picking up blue makes it read as shadow

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint sticks and twigs in the back

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap bushes beside the cabin
